fixed_regression_scenarios.expected_failure_signature: Moderate lock-in: max_consecutive_steering_run=187, stuck onset ~step 475, final unique_cells=460 (vs ~600 for a healthy episode on this layout family), policy/teacher ratio degraded in the original single-episode test.

Severe lock-in: max_consecutive_steering_run=401, stuck onset ~step 197, final unique_cells=187 -- the most severe known lock-in case found so far, on a layout whose own siblings score well in aggregate (median ratio 0.761).

notes: Deliberately stresses sparse/irregular geometry, low density, and bursty respawn (long inter-group travel). obstacle_level=0 throughout -- these are valid easy-stage layouts (escapability_validated, in-range population), not intermediate content; failures here reflect policy robustness, not a missing obstruction-recovery skill. Use a lower performance floor than easy_heldout, but still require no zero-kill episodes, no unrecoverable physical stagnation, and sane EVA behavior.
